question:
Consider the intermolecular hydrogen-bond network of this crystal. Count an H-bond D-H...A when D and A are N or O, the H atom is covalently bonded to D, H...A <= 2.50 A and the D-H...A angle >= 120 deg, and D and A belong to different molecules. Treat every molecule as a node and every such H-bond as an edge, in the infinite crystal. What is the dimensionality of the connected H-bonded aggregates, and along which lattice direction(s) do they extend? Options: 0D (finite clusters, e.g. dimers), 1D_a / 1D_b / 1D_c (infinite chains running along a, b or c), 1D_other (chains along another direction), 2D_ab / 2D_ac / 2D_bc (infinite layers parallel to that lattice plane), 2D_other (layers parallel to another plane), 3D (a framework).
Answer with JSON only: {"network": "<one of 0D|1D_a|1D_b|1D_c|1D_other|2D_ab|2D_ac|2D_bc|2D_other|3D>"}
gold_method: Periodic quotient graph of molecules with the stated H-bond criteria; dimensionality = rank of the lattice translations accumulated around closed paths; direction from the shortest generating vectors (1D) or their cross product (2D).
why_hard_from_cif_text: No H-bond list is given in the CIF; the model must find all intermolecular D-H...A contacts across symmetry copies and then track which lattice translations the closed H-bond paths accumulate (periodic-graph rank) to get 0D/1D/2D/3D and the propagation direction.

tui_feasibility.reason: 528-atom cell, H-bonds not drawn; a 2D layer spanning b and c cannot be traced beyond one cell from cluttered frames.
